data.narrative:
Flock Safety is a Series G-stage defense and security company seeking valuation guidance against a peer universe of 13 same-sector comparables spanning similar valuation tiers, including 2 public names (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers. The private comp set includes Shield AI ($12.7B, Series G), Helsing ($18.0B, Series E), Castelion ($13.0B, Series C), Saronic ($9.2B, Series D), and Quantum-Systems ($8.0B, Series D).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.25x multiplier typical of Series G advancement to Flock's last post-money valuation of $7.5B, yielding $9.4B. Peer-median analysis across the 13-company Defense & Security comp set produces a median valuation of $4.4B, with a range spanning $2.1B to $18.0B. These methodologies reflect the heterogeneity within frontier-tech security valuations—particularly the wide dispersion between earlier-stage outliers and later-stage private names.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $3.7B (low) to $10.8B (high), with a median of $6.9B. Flock's current $7.5B valuation sits within this range, proximate to the median. Key uncertainties center on peer comparability—stage progression and capital efficiency vary substantially within the Defense & Security sector—and the limited public-market reference points for late-stage, capital-intensive frontier-tech names.
